title: Add sell functionality and quantity tracking to semen straw inventory

requirements.text: Add a quantity field to the SemenStraw type in the backend data model to track the number of straws available for each record
acceptanceCriteria: SemenStraw type includes a quantity field of type Nat
Quantity represents the number of straws in inventory for that record
All existing CRUD operations handle the quantity field appropriately

requirements.text: Update the add straw form in the frontend to include a quantity input field that accepts positive integers
acceptanceCriteria: AddStrawForm component includes a quantity input field
Quantity field validates that the value is a positive integer
Form submission includes the quantity value when creating new straws

requirements.text: Display the quantity column in the inventory table showing the current quantity for each semen straw record
acceptanceCriteria: InventoryTable component displays a quantity column
Quantity values are clearly visible for each straw record
Column is positioned logically within the existing table layout

requirements.text: Add the ability to edit quantity in the EditStrawForm component
acceptanceCriteria: EditStrawForm includes a quantity input field pre-filled with current value
Users can update the quantity when editing a straw record
Quantity field validates positive integers on edit

requirements.text: Add a sell/sale functionality to record semen straw sales with fields for sale date, buyer information, quantity sold, and sale price
acceptanceCriteria: Backend includes a Sale type with fields: saleId, strawId, saleDate, buyerName, quantitySold, and salePrice
Backend provides functions to record a sale and retrieve sale records
Frontend includes a form or dialog to record a sale for a specific straw
Recording a sale reduces the quantity of the associated straw record
Sales history is accessible from the frontend

requirements.text: Display a sell/sale action button or option in the inventory table for each straw record to initiate the sale recording process
acceptanceCriteria: Each row in the inventory table includes a sell button or action
Clicking the sell button opens a sale recording form/dialog
The sell option is clearly visible and accessible

constraints: Maintain the existing agricultural-themed design when adding new UI elements
Ensure quantity updates are properly validated to prevent negative values
Sale transactions must maintain data integrity between straw quantity and sale records
